onboarding.title: Get more out of PlanQ

invite_client.label: Invite a client
invite_client.why: Conversations and tasks start with a client.

start_conversation.label: Start a conversation
start_conversation.why: Requests arrive in conversations, and tasks are born there.

create_task.label: Create your first task
create_task.why: Once it has an assignee and a due date, it gets tracked.
create_task.wikiQuery: Create a task and assign an owner

enable_notifications.label: Turn on notifications
enable_notifications.why: New messages and deadlines reach you even when PlanQ is closed.

connect_mail.label: Connect a mail account
connect_mail.why: Incoming mail is linked to clients and projects automatically

connect_calendar.label: Connect your calendar
connect_calendar.why: Your Google events show up in the PlanQ calendar

install_app.label: Install the mobile app
install_app.why: Get notified and reply on the go

connect_ai_app.label: Connect an AI app (ChatGPT, Claude)
connect_ai_app.why: Look things up and leave records by chatting

invite_team.label: Invite teammates
invite_team.why: Requests need someone to go to

request_task.label: Request work from a colleague
request_task.why: Set a colleague as assignee and it lands in their “Needs attention” (accepting a request counts too)

project_task.label: Add a task inside a project
project_task.why: Tasks, chat and files gather per project
project_task.wikiQuery: Create a project and sort/group the list

ai_task.label: Add tasks by voice or AI
ai_task.why: Write or say it (“Add by voice” at the bottom right) and it becomes tasks. Connect ChatGPT or Claude to do it in a conversation

team_chat.label: Talk in a team chat
team_chat.why: Turn any message into a task

create_event.label: Create an event
create_event.why: Meetings and deadlines show on the team calendar
create_event.wikiQuery: Create an event and set the time

record_meeting.label: Record a meeting in Q note
record_meeting.why: Record or upload and get a summary plus task suggestions

upload_file.label: Upload a file
upload_file.why: Keep it next to the work so nobody has to hunt for it

create_document.label: Write a document
create_document.why: Minutes, plans and quotes in the same place

client_chat.label: Talk in a client chat
client_chat.why: Client requests turn straight into tasks

issue_invoice.label: Create an invoice
issue_invoice.why: Work and billing attach to the same project

onboarding.stagesWikiQuery: 5 stages for your team to settle into PlanQ

1.name: Share and request tasks
1.why: Record work as tasks instead of in conversation, and request work from each other. When everyone sees who does what by when, “how is that going?” drops.

2.name: Communicate in chat and mail
2.why: Talk about work next to the work, not in a personal messenger. Requests from chat become tasks right there.

3.name: Calendar and meetings
3.why: Make every meeting end with notes and tasks.

4.name: Files and documents
4.why: End “where was that file?”. Keep files and documents next to tasks and projects.

5.name: Work with clients
5.why: Bring clients into the flow your team already runs. Client requests and invoices attach to the same project.
